captions.known_condition_pairs: Paired endpoint errors for all 33 previously used near-field conditions with boundary CVT. Historical executions are reused only after configuration and product verification and retain their original identities; 25 missing candidate episodes are newly executed. The logarithmic axis includes all endpoints and the unchanged 0.12 m task tolerance. These development conditions do not estimate out-of-distribution reliability.
captions.new_start_outcomes: All 72 episodes in 12 predeclared new-start condition blocks. Each block pairs three deployment modules and two motion-estimation priors using identical physical initialization. S denotes safe task completion, G the unchanged G500 contract, F incomplete tasks, and H hard-safety violations; endpoint errors include failures. One fixed new seed and designed geometries are used, without population confidence intervals.

intervals: None: shared-seed designed condition blocks, not iid arbitrary-shape draws
